channel.title: The Sun Media Corporation - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Sun Media Corporation (thesundaily.my)

item.title: Elderly man drowns after falling into ditch in Perak village
item.description: An 83-year-old man died after falling into a ditch in Pekan Sungang Dulang, Hutan Melintang, with his body recovered by fire and rescue personnel.

item.title: Malaysia celebrates seven internationally recognised Ramsar wetland sites
item.description: Malaysia is proud of its seven Ramsar sites, covering over 5.19 million hectares, which provide economic and environmental benefits, says minister.

item.title: 33 Selangor FC supporters remanded over stadium bridge commotion
item.description: Police remand 33 Selangor FC fans after commotion on a drawbridge ahead of a Super League match against Terengganu FC in Kuala Terengganu.

item.title: Government urges Islamic schools to register for aid and monitoring
item.description: Islamic Educational Institutions are encouraged to register with authorities to access RM200 million in government aid and ensure proper monitoring.

item.title: Bad Bunny makes Grammys history with first Spanish-language Album of the Year win
item.description: Puerto Rican star Bad Bunny wins Album of the Year at the Grammys, the first Spanish-language album to do so, while delivering a political message.

item.title: Grammys red carpet dazzles with monochrome, sheer looks and protest pins
item.description: The 68th Grammys red carpet featured black and white elegance, daring sheer gowns, and 'ICE OUT' protest pins against US immigration crackdowns

item.title: Dalai Lama expresses gratitude after winning first Grammy award
item.description: The Dalai Lama wins his first Grammy for an audiobook, calling it a recognition of shared universal responsibility from his exile base in Indi

item.title: Slope repair on Jalan Lojing-Gua Musang to start in March
item.description: Repair works for the landslide-damaged Jalan Lojing-Gua Musang slope will begin in March, with a temporary road diversion planned first.

item.title: Former bank manager fined RM210,000 for accepting over RM211,000 in bribes
item.description: A former bank sales manager in Melaka was fined RM210,000 after pleading guilty to 20 charges of accepting bribes for housing loan referrals.

item.title: TVB Stars launch Ebene Foot Sleeve at Sunway Velocity Mall
item.description: Elaine Yiu & Brian Chu unveil Ebene's plantar fasciitis foot sleeve with 1-hour comfort improvement claim
